reason: Episode pulled RankMySEO data into docs/31-seo-plan.md and hit several recurring pitfalls: plan-cap sampling shifted a count that looked like a fix, an unloaded URL list was at risk of being guessed, AI-generated structure advice conflicted with the sponsor-separation rule, and the user asked for an extra menu mid-task. No existing SEO snapshot skill in index; seo category exists (social-share-image-replacement), so category reused. Project level: it names this repo's doc and ADRs.

The episode shipped snippet changes and then had to tell the user the CTR effect could only be read about 28 days later. Snapshot sections need the change date and that measurement lag, or the next snapshot reads an early dip as a regression.
